2026_01_NYJ_TEN.headline: Tennessee can attack the spots New York’s final injury report leaves thinnest
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.paragraph1: The Jets ruled Joseph Ossai and Tim Patrick out, with Kene Nwangwu and D’Angelo Ponds doubtful, while the Titans will be without Cedric Gray. New York’s losses touch both edge depth and the slot-secondary rotation, creating specific places Tennessee can test rather than a broad roster disadvantage. The Titans can use motion and condensed formations to force communication from altered defensive groupings; the Jets need their front to win quickly and keep Tennessee from repeatedly isolating replacement coverage responsibilities.
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.model_rationale: Tennessee can create favorable matchups by moving receivers across an altered Jets coverage rotation, especially if New York cannot generate pressure without exposing those replacements.
